notes: Paper reports first constraints on axionlike particles from binary neutron star gravitational wave event GW170817. The primary result is a mass-independent exclusion band in the (m_a, f_a) plane: axions with masses m_a ≲ 10^-11 eV and decay constants 1.6×10^16 GeV < f_a < 10^18 GeV are excluded at 3σ confidence level. The constraint arises from the absence of detectable dephasing in the GW170817 inspiral waveform due to axion-mediated forces between neutron stars. The lower bound f_a > 1.6×10^16 GeV comes from the Bayesian analysis of GW170817 data; the upper bound f_a < 10^18 GeV is theoretical (critical radius condition for phase transition in NS). The constraint is independent of dark matter assumptions. Data points encode the rectangular exclusion region: two corners at (m_a=10^-13 eV, f_a=1.6×10^16 GeV) and (m_a=10^-11 eV, f_a=10^18 GeV), with horizontal extrapolation to the massless limit for m_a < 10^-13 eV. | selector: text (sole candidate) | Auto-corrected couplings: ×1e-20 (×1.00e-20, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=3.2e-05)|)
